process.title: How we work
process.subtitle: Take a peek behind the scenes and discover our custom web-design process. We build bespoke websites for brands of any size that deliver measurable results.

steps.title: Discovery
body: We start with a short call and a mini-brief questionnaire.
We translate business goals into web goals (what conversion we expect, who we must convince).
We define success metrics and map risks/constraints.

steps.title: Direction & cadence
body: We assemble scope, sitemap and timeline.
We fix milestones, owners and the communication rhythm.

steps.title: Wireframe & prototype
body: Mobile-first wireframes turned into a clickable prototype.
We test behavior here; logic can be refined before visual design.

steps.title: Design system
body: A coherent visual language: colors, type, components.
Key pages in final visuals with states.

steps.title: Development & integration
body: Fast, SEO-friendly code with all integrations in place.
Continuous staging link so you can follow progress.
bullets: Responsive build, Core Web Vitals focus

steps.title: Test, launch, care
body: Device tests, performance tuning, SEO basics.
After launch we train you and fine-tune.
